meta.title: Dota Underlords reference data (Valve, 2019-2020)
meta.purpose: Design inspiration for Digi-Tactics. Values are copied from game data files, official patch notes and the community wiki. Missing values are "unknown" or null; nothing is estimated.

conventions.attack_rate_seconds: Seconds between attacks (lower is faster). The wiki labels this "Attack Speed".
conventions.underlord_arrays: Underlord arrays of 6 are ranks 1-6 (rank-up every 5 rounds, max at round 40) in the final data. Older Underlord data used 8 or 10 ranks.
conventions.item_arrays_final: Several final-patch items carry 6-value arrays. The first value matches the standard in-match item. The other five are not documented; they are probably City Crawl prestige item levels (unconfirmed).
conventions.tiers: Tier = shop cost in gold. Tier 5 was called "Ace" from 2019-08-30 to 2020-02-25.

notes: Has a duration of 20 seconds.
Unlike most abilities, damage from Sticky Napalm generates mana.
However, this does not count as a separate damage instance and will not increase mana gain if Batrider would have already gained the maximum amount of mana with no Sticky Napalm.

However, the maximum stack count is not bound to the Sticky Napalm debuff itself, but to the Batrider that's casting the skill (a 1-star Batrider will not be able to increase the stack count once it's 4 or more, even if the Sticky Napalm debuff was first applied by a 2-star Batrider).

hobgen_afterburn_desc_alt.name: The fireball sets the area it lands on fire for {s:burn_duration} seconds with a {s:dot_dps_per_level} damage per second effect on enemies standing in it.

hobgen_burningdownthehouse.name: Burning Down The House
hobgen_burningdownthehouse.desc: Whenever Hobgen attacks a unit on fire, the fire will spread to a random adjacent enemy.

hobgen_greasefire.name: Grease Fire
hobgen_greasefire.desc: Hobgen gains {s:hype_per_unit} hype per unit hit in the blast.

hobgen_hotrod.name: Hot Rod
hobgen_hotrod.desc: Hobgen's attack speed is increased by {s:speed_per_level}.

hobgen_hotrod_desc_alt.name: Hobgen's attack speed is increased by {s:speed_per_level}.

hobgen_implosion.name: Implosion
hobgen_implosion.desc: Hobgen launches a fireball at a target that deals {s:damage_bonus} damage split evenly amongst all targets adjacent and setting them all on fire.

hobgen_keepitsecret.name: Keep It Secret
hobgen_keepitsecret.desc: Whenever an enemy is set on fire, they are silenced for {s:silence_duration} seconds. This effect can happen again every time the fire expires.

hobgen_letsgetnuts.name: Ya Burnt!
hobgen_letsgetnuts.desc: While under the effects of Let's Go Crazy, Hobgen doubles the damage rate of all burning units.

hobgen_letsgocrazyunlock.name: Let's Go Crazy
hobgen_letsgocrazyunlock.desc: Hobgen's attacks now reach the entire battlefield, and your entire army gains {s:aspd} increased attack speed. Hobgen will continually switch targets to units that are not on fire.

hobgen_manabomb.name: Drain Bomb
hobgen_manabomb.desc: The explosion no longer damages and instead drains {s:mana_burn} points of Mana.

hobgen_moltenarmor.name: Molten Armor
hobgen_moltenarmor.desc: Hobgen gains {s:armor_per_level} armor and sets adjacent attackers on fire.

hobgen_moltenarmor_desc_alt.name: Hobgen gains {s:armor_per_level} armor and sets adjacent attackers on fire.

hobgen_pyrotechnics.name: Pyrotechnics
hobgen_pyrotechnics.desc: Friendly units gain {s:lifesteal_pct}% life steal while attacking enemies that are on fire.

hobgen_shockwave.name: Shockwave
hobgen_shockwave.desc: Hobgen launches a fireball at a target that deals {s:damage_base} damage split evenly amongst all targets adjacent, stunning them for {s:stun_duration} seconds and setting them all on fire.

hobgen_supercharge_abilitymana.name: Feedback Loop
hobgen_supercharge_abilitymana.desc: Super-Charged units gain mana from damage caused by abilities. Upon casting, they deal damage equal to the mana cost to adjacent enemies.

hobgen_supercharge_explode.name: Kaboom
hobgen_supercharge_explode.desc: Whenever a Super-Charged unit dies, it explodes doing {s:explode_damage_pct}% of its max health in damage to adjacent enemies and setting them on fire for {s:fire_duration} seconds.

hobgen_supercharge_resetcooldowns.name: Spark
hobgen_supercharge_resetcooldowns.desc: Whenever a unit is Super-Charged its cooldowns are reset.

hobgen_supercharge_targetfire.name: Burn Out
hobgen_supercharge_targetfire.desc: Super-Charged units have a {s:stun_chance}% chance of stunning targets for {s:stun_duration} seconds.

imabouttobreak.name: Broken Hearts, Broken Bones
imabouttobreak.desc: The target is BROKEN while affected by Pure Pain.

instantregret.desc: Friendly units affected by Martyr's Boon BREAK their killer for {s:duration} seconds.

julltalent01.name: Here's the Beef
julltalent01.desc: Jull gains {s:armor_per_enemy} armor per adjacent enemy.

julltalent02.name: Frosty Fist
julltalent02.desc: Jull gains {s:crit_chance}% chance per adjacent enemy to crit for {s:crit_bonus_pct}% damage

julltalent03.name: The Wall
julltalent03.desc: Friendly Units in the same row as Jull gain {s:armor_pct}% of his armor

julltalent04.name: My Right Hand Man
julltalent04.desc: The allied unit that starts combat to the right of Jull gets {s:hp_bonus}% of Jull's HP as bonus HP for the duration of combat.

julltalent06.name: Me and the Boys
julltalent06.desc: Any allies immediately to Jull's left or right attack the same enemy Jull is attacking.

julltalent07.name: To Your Health
julltalent07.desc: Jull gains {s:damage_reduction_pct}% damage reduction for {s:buff_duration} seconds. Adjacent allies are healed for {s:heal_pct}% of damage taken by Jull during this time.

julltalent08.name: Roundhouse
julltalent08.desc: Jull gains {s:damage_reduction_pct}% damage reduction, {s:attack_speed} attack speed, and {s:life_steal_pct}% lifesteal for {s:buff_duration} seconds.

julltalent09.name: Sea Slime
julltalent09.desc: Affected enemies miss their next {s:num_attacks} attacks.

julltalent11.name: Worth a Shot
julltalent11.desc: Affected enemies are purged of their buffs. Affected allies in the area are purged of their debuffs.

julltalent13.name: When Push Comes to Shove
julltalent13.desc: Jull is healed {s:heal_per_enemy} hp per enemy affected.

julltalent14.name: This Punch is Spiked
julltalent14.desc: Enemies in the path take {s:push_damage} damage

julltalent15.name: A Little Chin Music
julltalent15.desc: Jull gains {s:hype_per_enemy} hype per enemy affected by Punchtron

julltalent16.name: Take a Seat
julltalent16.desc: Punched unit gets stunned for {s:stun_duration} seconds plus an additional {s:additional_stun_duration} seconds if it hits the edge of the board.

julltalent17.name: Barrels of Fun
julltalent17.desc: Jull calls in barrels from the edges of the board. If they hit an ally, they gain {s:attack_speed_buff_pct} attack speed. If they hit an enemy, they take {s:damage_taken_debuff_pct}% more magical and physical damage for the rest of the fight.

julltalent18.name: Happy Hour
julltalent18.desc: Jull buys a round for all members of your army. When taking damage, {s:damage_distributed_pct}% of it is received immediately, and the rest is taken over {s:damage_distributed_duration} seconds.

julltalent21.name: Fighting Angry
julltalent21.desc: Friendly Unit's damage is increased by {s:damage_increase_pct}% while they are taking damage.

julltalent22.name: Walk it off
julltalent22.desc: 50% of the damage-over-time portion of the damage taken is prevented.

meltingpoint.name: Melting Point
meltingpoint.desc: Units on fire lose {s:armor_loss_per_second} armor a second until the fire is extinguished.

precisionstrikes.name: Danger Close
precisionstrikes.desc: The bombs will only land on the enemy's side of the board.

smallwound.desc: Anessix no longer sacrifices health when casting Martyr's Boon.

sweettalksweettalk.desc: Anessix gains +{s:hype_pct}% Hype generation while affected by Martyr's Boon.

yourpainismygain.name: Transfusion
yourpainismygain.desc: Anessix and her companion heal for the same amount of damage done by Pure Pain.

shop.free_reroll: After losing a round to a player, the next round has one free reroll; it does not stack (2019-08-02). Draws stopped granting it on 2019-12-28. [N]

shop.roll_procedure: For each slot: roll a tier from the level odds, then pick uniformly among all copies of that tier still in the pool. Example from the wiki: chance of Disruptor in a tier-4 slot with 3 Disruptors owned and 11 other tier-4 heroes at 12 copies = 9 / (11*12 + 9) = 6.4%. [W: Shop]

player_damage.final_formula: Loser takes: sum over surviving enemy heroes of floor(1 + power/3), plus Underlord damage, plus round damage. Power = tier (1-star), tier+2 (2-star), tier+4 (3-star). Summons deal 0. Surviving Underlord: 1 before round 30, 2 from round 30. Round damage starts at 0 and rises by 1 every 10 rounds. [W: Damage; N: 2019-12-18]
history: 2019-08-02: round damage removed for rounds 4-9; starts at round 11 at 2, then 3 from round 20, 4 from round 30.
2019-11-15: "Round Damage is back, at 1 per every 10 rounds" (1 at 10-19, 2 at 20-29).
2019-12-18: unit damage changed to 1 + (Power Level / 3); higher-tier units deal more.
Before 2019-12-18 the per-unit damage rule is unknown from the sources read (Vicious Intent, a beta global item, added +1 per surviving unit).
player_damage.duos: If both partners win, their damage is summed against the losing team. If one player of each team wins, only the difference is applied to the team that dealt less. Equal damage = no loss. [W: Duos]
player_damage.knockout: Players start with 4 lives and lose 1 per lost round. [W: Knockout]

beta_systems_removed.jail: The Big Update (2019-10-24) to 2019-12-18. Every 24 hours a set of heroes was barred from the pool. From 2019-11-15: 8-12 heroes per day, up to 3 from one alliance, one Ace per day, and tiers 1-4 balanced to within 1 ban of each other. Removed 2019-12-18 ("Jailbreak"). [N; W: Jail]
beta_systems_removed.hype: 2019-10-24 to 2019-12-18. Underlords spent no resource but needed Hype above a threshold to cast. Passive Hype per second plus per-condition gains (Anessix +1/s per allied Demon, Hobgen +1/s per burning unit), +10 per kill, -5/s while stunned or hexed, double gain after the enemy Underlord dies. 2019-11-15: Hype instead scaled Underlord damage (up to +50%) and cooldown speed (up to 40% faster). [N: The Big Changelog, 2019-11-15]
beta_systems_removed.underlord_talents: 2019-10-24 to 2019-12-18. One talent picked every 5 rounds from round 10 to 35; round 20 pick was the ultimate (cast once per fight). Anessix and Hobgen had 22 talents each, 11 locked until unlocked by playing. Knockout allowed only the ultimate pick. [N; W: Anessix/Old Abilities, Hobgen/Old Abilities]
beta_systems_removed.global_items: Items that applied a player-wide rule rather than sitting on a hero (Recruiter, Expanded Roster, Friends and Family Discount, A Higher Class of Criminal, Aegis, Silver Lining, Smuggler...). Removed 2019-12-18. [N: Jull-tide Changelog]
beta_systems_removed.alliance_items: Global items tied to one alliance (Tooth and Claw, Coordinated Assault, Soul Sucking Syphon, Unstable Reactor, Font of Creation...). Moved to their own category 2019-07-19, disabled 2019-08-01; some effects were folded into alliances. [W: Items]
beta_systems_removed.ace_tier: 2019-08-30 to 2020-02-25. Tier 5 heroes were "Aces", each tied to one alliance, with an extra Ace effect while that alliance had at least one level active. Renamed Tier 5 and Ace effects removed at Season One. [N: 2019-08-31, 2020-02-25]

modes.Standard: 8-player free-for-all, last player standing. Casual and Ranked queues from 2019-08-02. There was no separate mode called "Free-for-all"; Standard is the FFA mode.
modes.Duos: Added 2019-10-24. 8 teams of 2; shared health pool (100) and shared level; partners can send heroes and gold. Pool size doubled. Ranked Duos added with the 2019-12-18 leaderboard update. [N; W: Duos]
modes.Freestyle: Added 2019-10-24 as a sandbox: place any unit, item or Underlord, unlimited gold, change ranks and game speed, share boards by code. Later grouped under Training with the tutorial. [N; W: Training]
modes.Knockout: Added 2019-11-26 (casual), ranked from 2019-12-06. Pick 1 of 3 starter crews of 5 heroes from two alliances (one reroll); start at level 5 and level every 2 rounds; 2 copies combine; item every odd round; Underlord picked after round 1; 4 lives, lose 1 per loss; paired against players with similar health; no interest, no streak gold; base gold starts at 6 and rises (+1 on even rounds, +2 on odd rounds: 6, 7, 9, 10, 12 ... 19 at round 10). Average 10 minutes. [N: Outlanders Update; W: Knockout]
modes.Classic: Added 2020-08-27 as an option in Standard Casual and private matches: no Underlords, creep loot rounds return. [N: New Blood On The Streets; W: Classic Mode]
modes.City Crawl: Single-player campaign added with Season One (2020-02-25). Four districts (Little Revtel, New Tenebrous, Port Slipshade, The Warrens), each with 36 challenges: 13 Objectives (match tasks tied to a specific Underlord), 19 Street Fights (Knockout-style fights vs fixed boards or restricted bots; 2 lives, no timer, levels 6/8/10 by round, fixed base gold per fight, free reroll on loss) and 4 Puzzles (single round, limited units/cells/items and a net-worth cap; score = net worth, unit count, fight time, ranked on leaderboards). Clearing nodes opens paths. Street Fight item drops (14 per Underlord). City Keys skip a node. After clearing the city you can Prestige up to 5 times: Street Fights get harder (your units deal 25% less damage, +10% per prestige, up to 65%) and Street Fight items get stronger. Part of the content required the paid Battle Pass. [W: City Crawl]
modes.Bot matches / Tutorial: Bot games at several difficulties; "Hardcore (XP)" bots count for Battle Pass XP. Tutorial with Ricky Ravenhook added 2019-11-26 and auto-starts for players with fewer than 3 games. [N; W: Training]
modes.Private lobbies: Party/private matches; custom jails via board code were supported from 2019-10-31 until the jail was removed. [N: 2019-10-31]

ranked.minor_tiers: Each rank below Lord has five minor levels I-V (green, blue, red, pink, gold).
ranked.system_2019-08-01: Visible Rank Score changes by finishing place only, not opponent rank. Bonus points when reaching a new minor rank. A major rank, once reached, cannot be lost. Ranked unlocks after 5 casual games. Casual queue added. [N: Ranked, 2019-07-26]

party_rank_changes.note: Place is counted only among non-party players. Parties up to 3; highest member rank is used for matchmaking.

ranked.lord_of_white_spire: Reached at 7,600 Rank Score; on promotion the score is moved to about 15,000. From 2019-08-15 Lords use Elo with K=3 on scores x10; equal-score lobbies give +105/+75/+45/+15/-15/-45/-75/-105 by place. Players below Big Boss are ignored for a Lord's update. Leaderboard (underlords.com) updates hourly; must play 5 ranked games in 5 days to appear. [N: Lords of White Spire, 2019-08-14; W: Ranked]
ranked.other_queues: Ranked Knockout (2019-12-06) and Ranked Duos had their own leaderboards from 2019-12-18. [N]
ranked.resets: 2020-08-27: ranks above Grifter dropped one major rank; Grifter and lower reset to minor level I; Lords set to Big Boss I. [N: New Blood On The Streets]

battle_passes.Proto Pass: Free test battle pass from 2019-07-12 for all beta players. Match points by place: Standard 150/120/100/90/80/70/60/50, Knockout 100/80/60/50/40/30/20/10 (Knockout values added later). Daily challenges, one reroll each per 23 hours. Achievements also gave Proto Pass XP (2019-08-02). [W: Proto Pass; N]
battle_passes.Season One Battle Pass: From 2020-02-25. Over 100 reward levels, 1,000 XP per level. Many rewards free; full access (all City Crawl content and all rewards) cost $4.99 and gave no gameplay advantage. Match XP by place: Standard/Duos 400/300/250/200/150/100/50/30, Knockout 150/120/100/80/60/40/20/10. Daily challenges worth 200/300/400 (kill units, earn end-of-turn gold, cast spells, deal magic damage, heal, lifesteal, summon). City Crawl tasks gave 300/600/1,000 XP. Rewards were cosmetics: boards, board props, wanted posters, Underlord outfits, win-streak effects, sprays, and Street Fight items. [N: Season One; W: Season One Battle Pass]
battle_passes.Season 2: No Season 2 launched. Valve's last content update was New Blood On The Streets (2020-08-27), a rotation within Season One; the last patch was 2020-11-19. The client file named season_02_battle_pass.json is registered in events.json as "Season 1, EventID:2".
